# Owlee by coolLabs

Owlee is an open-source, self-hosted app for uptime monitoring, status pages, incidents, error tracking and cookieless web analytics. It is coming soon.

- [Owlee](https://owlee.io/)
- [Source code](https://github.com/coollabsio/owlee)
- [Launch updates on X](https://x.com/heyandras)
